parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Set this parameter to a value that is generated from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** value as the **ClientToken** value. The **RequestId** value is different for each API request.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint that you want to delete belongs. You can call the [ListBasicEndpointGroups](~~~~) operation to query the endpoint group ID of a basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: EndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint that you want to delete from the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to **ap-southeast-1**.
